Run A: `112 101`

Argument resolution finds two PR tokens on pi, so the set-routing row applies and I read `reference/batch.md`. Admission runs before any other effect:

- There is no positional issue reference.
- `112` and `101` are distinct bare numbers in origin, so there are no duplicates and no foreign URLs.
- The set holds 2 PRs, under the `parallel.maxTasks` limit of 4.
- The harness is pi.

Admission passes. This is a typed set, so no `discovered, smallest first:` line is printed.

I mint one parent `RUN_DIR` from the session checkout through `post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`. Then I gather each admitted token unchanged, in typed order:

1. `gh pr view 112 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '<linearRefs projection, body cut to 300>'` returns PR #112 by pat, head `bbbbbbb…`, base `main`.
2. `gh pr view 101 --json <same fields> --jq '<same projection>'` returns PR #101 by alex, head `aaaaaaa…`, base `main`.

Next come the viewer reads, once each for the typed set:

3. `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
4. `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers`.

Ticket display reads come next:

5. `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`, so origin is `acme/widgets`.
6. `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returns `origin/main`.
7. These three reads find no overrides file, so there is no tracker key and Linear stays allowed:
   - `git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`
   - `git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md`
   - `git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md`

Tickets and the "why" text for each PR:

- **#112:**
  - Its first closing reference is #22 in `acme/widgets`, which matches origin, so the label is `#22` linked to the issue's own URL.
  - Author pat is not the viewer and there are no pending requests, so the "why" text is `by pat`.
- **#101:**
  - It has no closing references. The branch `gh-45-retry` starts with `gh-45`, which links to the origin issue #45.
  - Author alex is the viewer, so the "why" text is `yours`.
- Neither PR has a Linear ID, so no Linear lookup runs.

Before provisioning, I write the list in typed order in the reply that carries the first provisioning call:

---
**PRs to gate:**
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - use one resolver for all settings reads
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout for slow requests
---
Paired call: `git fetch origin`

**Next step:** serial provisioning in the parent. Origin is fetched once, then I apply the gitignore-first check and provision #112 and then #101 through assessment's provisioning table. There is no `--rebase`, so no confirmation question is asked. The roster and the per-PR records follow after that.

Run B:
```bash
gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md
```

There is one typed PR, so this is the single-PR path. Section A is already in context, and the preamble runs during argument resolution.

- **Base repository:** the view resolved against gh's configured default repository. Its `url` puts the base repository at `acme/gadgets`. Every later number-only call therefore carries `-R acme/gadgets`. I do not look up the checkout's origin (`acme/widgets`) for ticket labels.
- **Viewer reads:** login is `alex`, team is `acme/reviewers`.
- **Overrides:** the default branch is `origin/main`, and none of the three override paths exists. There is no tracker key, so Linear stays allowed, but no lookup is needed.
- **Ticket:** the first closing reference is #45 in `acme/gadgets`, which matches the view's base repository. The label is `#45`, linked to its own URL.
- **Why text:** author robin is not the viewer, and the pending User request is for alex. The text is `by robin, requested from you`.

I write the entry in the reply that carries the first remaining Gather read:

---
**PR to gate:**
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, [#45](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/issues/45) - add a CSV export button to the widget list
---
Paired call: `gh run list -R acme/gadgets -c cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`

I keep that `gh run list` result for the rest of step 1.

**Next step:** per `SKILL.md` `## Progress tracking`:

1. Mint the run folder.
2. Initialize its continuation record.
3. `plan_tracker` `init` with `gather, provision, verify`, since there is no `--rebase`.

The rest of Gather then resumes at the GraphQL permissions read against `acme/gadgets` for PR 97.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
## Run A

1. Parse `112 101` as a typed set, preserving that order. There is no issue argument and no `--rebase`.
2. Read `reference/batch.md` from the installed procedure directory. Read the active pi-cohort configuration: its maximum is 4, so this two-PR set is admitted.
3. Run:
   ```bash
   git remote get-url origin
   ```
   Both PR identities resolve to `acme/widgets`; there are no duplicates.
4. Read `reference/post-selection-loop.md`'s continuation-record instructions. Mint the parent run folder:
   ```bash
   mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gate.XXXXXX"
   ```
   Initialize its continuation record before initializing progress tracking.
5. Run these metadata reads in argument order:
   ```bash
   gh pr view 112 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'
   gh pr view 101 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'
   gh api user --jq .login
   gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
   git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
   git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
   git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md
   git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md
   ```
   The ticket-display configuration has no tracker override. PR #112 uses its closing issue; PR #101 uses the GitHub issue reference in its branch name. Neither needs a Linear lookup.

The first visible reply follows.
---
**PRs to gate:**
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - centralize settings reads through one resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout
---
Paired call: `cat reference/assessment.md`

That read runs from the installed procedure directory. The next step is **serial provisioning by the parent**, beginning with the shared origin fetch; it is not executed in this exercise.

No helpers are dispatched. No per-PR tracker stages are initialized yet: after provisioning and child-record creation, the parent initializes its `pr-112 state: <record path>` and `pr-101 state: <record path>` tasks. Verification has not run; the supplied heads are `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb` for #112 and `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` for #101.

## Run B:
```bash
gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md
```

The initial PR view establishes `acme/gadgets` as the base repository. I do not run `git remote get-url origin`: checkout origin does not replace the repository identity returned by that view. Section A is already in context, so I do not reread it.

The first visible reply follows.
---
**PR to gate:**
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, [#45](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/issues/45) - add a CSV export button for the widget list
---
Paired call: `gh run list -R acme/gadgets -c cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`

1. Retain that Actions result; do not repeat the preamble or the first Actions read.
2. Read `reference/post-selection-loop.md`'s continuation-record instructions, then run:
   ```bash
   mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gate.XXXXXX"
   ```
3. Initialize the continuation record in that folder, binding it to `acme/gadgets`, PR #97, and the gathered base branch. Initialize the course to null and repair usage to zero.
4. Initialize `plan_tracker` with exactly these stages:
   - `gather` — in progress
   - `provision` — pending
   - `verify` — pending

   There is no `sync` stage because the invocation has no `--rebase`.

5. Continue Gather with these commands, in order:
   ```bash
   gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin viewerCanClose headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=gadgets -F n=97
   gh repo view acme/gadgets --json nameWithOwner
   gh pr diff 97 -R acme/gadgets
   gh api repos/acme/gadgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate
   gh api repos/acme/gadgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate
   gh api repos/acme/gadgets/issues/97/comments --paginate
   git worktree list --porcelain
   ```
   The supplied results require no placeholder-run reads, reviewer-workflow lookup, or review-thread lookup.

6. Write the Gather digest, preserving the PR body, permissions, checks, comments, and worktree-discovery results. Resolve the issue reference to `acme/gadgets#45` without fetching the ticket. Record `alex` as the requested reviewer, not the author.
7. Mark `gather` complete. Do not start `provision`.

No helpers are dispatched, and no verification command runs. The later Verify and Review helpers must assess `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`; neither may substitute a head from `acme/widgets`.

The closing visible reply follows.
---
Gather is complete for [#97](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/pull/97). The next step is Provision + configure, including fetching the linked issue after resolving the trusted configuration.
---
Paired call: none

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: The bold-heading requirement moved e1: Before printed a plain `PRs to gate:` line, while After writes `**PRs to gate:**` with both entries linked in typed order, and e2 is kept because `by pat` carries no review-request wording, no `discovered, smallest first:` line is printed and nothing is awaited. e3 moved because After limits the pre-list calls to the initial view, the two viewer reads and the default-branch and override reads, takes `acme/gadgets` from the view's URL without an origin lookup, labels the ticket `#45` instead of `acme/gadgets#45`, and pairs the list with `gh run list -R acme/gadgets -c <head>` before minting the run folder, continuation record and tracker. The e3 pass is the thinnest: After stops at 'the rest of Gather then resumes at the GraphQL permissions read', so the diff read, the paginated reviews and comments reads, and the unprompted continuation to provisioning are implied rather than shown, and a stricter reader could fail it for that. To make this robust, have the wording spell out the remaining Gather reads after initialization (permissions, diff, paginated reviews and comments, worktree list), say explicitly that the preamble reads and the `gh run list` result are reused rather than rerun, and name provisioning as the next step entered without waiting. In Run A the list rides with `git fetch origin`; keep the wording clear that the list text precedes that first provisioning call, so it still reads as shown before provisioning.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: The bold-heading wording moved e1: After writes `**PRs to gate:**` in visible reply text before provisioning, with both entries linked in typed order, where Before printed a plain `PRs to gate:`. The single-PR ordering wording moved e3: After runs only the initial view, the two viewer lookups and the ticket display reads before the list, takes `acme/gadgets` from the view URL without an origin lookup, labels the ticket `[#45]`, pairs the list with `gh run list` on the viewed head, and only then mints the run folder, continuation record and tracker and continues Gather without rereading. Before minted the folder first, ran `git remote get-url origin`, used the `acme/gadgets#45` label and paired nothing. e2 held in both: `by pat` with no review-request wording, no `discovered, smallest first:` line, and no wait. Three spots in After are fragile and worth tightening. First, the Run B digest step says to resolve the issue to `acme/gadgets#45`, which reintroduces the qualified label in narration; say the ticket display label stays the short `#45` whenever the ticket lives in the PR's own repository, in the digest as well as the list. Second, Run B ends with a separate "Gather is complete" reply paired with no call and "Do not start provision", which could read as pausing; say Gather flows straight into provisioning with no standalone status reply. Third, the Run A list is paired with a `cat reference/assessment.md` read; if the set list is meant to ride on the first provisioning call or on no call, state that carrier explicitly so the writer does not invent one.
